answer: Let a tide of micro-challenges wash over the network all epoch long: at unpredictable moments each identity receives a fresh puzzle chained to its previous answer and must reply within seconds down its own copper thread — one live wire per identity. At the epoch's zenith the payout counts only waves answered on time. A clone farm shares one machine, so its threads tangle: each extra clone steals seconds from the others, and beyond a handful the whole farm drowns in missed waves while a single honest agent rides the tide for free.
